trust_decision.summary: Decide whether a caller-supplied path contains any Unicode category-C (control/format/surrogate/unassigned) character and throw CorruptedPathDetected if so; the decision is taken in WhitespacePathNormalizer::normalizePath, the single normalizer every Filesystem operation runs paths through before an adapter sees them (the old guard was skipped because preg_match with the /u modifier returns false, not 1, on malformed UTF-8).

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names WhitespacePathNormalizer and its control-character (CorruptedPathDetected) check outright, so a reader looks at normalizePath first.

fix_sites.entry_point: League\Flysystem\WhitespacePathNormalizer::normalizePath() (public class implementing League\Flysystem\PathNormalizer), reached from every League\Flysystem\Filesystem method, e.g. Filesystem::write at src/Filesystem.php:53-60
fix_sites.module_kind: core path normalizer, library public API

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The normalizer is a Filesystem-level feature: adapters are internal plumbing that are always wrapped by Filesystem (src/Filesystem.php:25-34), so a path handed straight to an adapter method is the caller's own responsibility, not this advisory's protection.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate valid multibyte UTF-8 filenames (e.g. "ıÇöü🤔.txt") must keep normalizing byte-for-byte; an over-broad fix such as an ASCII-only allow-list (/^[\x20-\x7E]+$/) or rejecting every byte >= 0x80 breaks international filenames, and WhitespacePathNormalizerTest has no non-ASCII case that would catch it.

O6_input_shapes: valid UTF-8 path containing a category-C character, e.g. "some\0/path.txt" and "s\x09i.php" (previously detected, still detected)
malformed UTF-8 byte sequence in the path, e.g. "foo\x80\x1bbar" (preg_match /u returned false, guard skipped; now throws)
malformed UTF-8 byte plus an embedded control character in the same path (the combined shape the new test case uses)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A control-character guard written into the wrapper before PathPrefixer::prefixPath (src/PathPrefixer.php:24-27) rewrites the location, instead of (or as well as) the normalizer.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This is the one place in the library that rewrites a caller path outside WhitespacePathNormalizer, and the prefixing adapter ships as its own composer package (config.subsplit-publish.json:59-62) that must support a range of core versions, so a maintainer could not rely on a new core API and would duplicate the check locally.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second local control-character check before PathPrefixer turns a path into a real filesystem path.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: src/Local is a separately published package (config.subsplit-publish.json:24-27) with its own PathPrefixer(prefix, DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR); a maintainer fixing a local-adapter path bug could add the guard there without touching core.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Validation of the mount path after splitting on '://' before dispatching to the mounted Filesystem.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: MountManager is a second FilesystemOperator facade that parses caller input itself; a maintainer hardening mount keys/paths could add a control-character check at that parse point.

O9_family: Improper neutralization of escape/meta/control sequences in paths (CWE-150), i.e. input validation of control characters reaching adapters (NUL truncation, CRLF injection into FTP/WebDAV-style protocol commands)

O10_build.toolchain: composer (php ^8.0.2, PSR-4 League\Flysystem\ => src) + PHPUnit ^9.5|^10 via phpunit.xml.dist; phpstan optional
O10_build.project_tests: src/WhitespacePathNormalizerTest.php (rejecting_funky_whitespace with dpFunkyWhitespacePaths at :135-138, plus path/traversal providers at :79-111 and :143-152) and src/FilesystemTest.php; the normalizer test is pure PHP and needs no services, while most adapter test cases under src/*/ need FTP/SFTP/MongoDB/cloud credentials (dev requires ext-mongodb, ext-ftp, aws/aws-sdk-php, google/cloud-storage)

j.j_sites_touched: src/WhitespacePathNormalizer.php (one guard at :26; all 21 Filesystem facade methods at src/Filesystem.php:36-238 funnel through it)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Rewrite the guard as preg_match(...) === 1, or swap in a byte-wise regex without the /u modifier, which still lets a malformed-UTF-8-only path (no control byte) through.
